name: Anime restyle
description: Restyle the video as hand-drawn anime with clean ink outlines, cel shading and painted backgrounds.

prompt.default: Redraw every frame, from the very first, as hand-drawn 2D anime: clean black ink outlines, flat cel-shaded colors and painted backgrounds. No photographic texture remains. Preserve the source subjects, action, camera motion and timing. Keep the visual treatment consistent across frames.
